meta_description:
803 likes, 31 comments - luke_coutinho on October 10, 2026: "Sometimes, without realising it, the things we say to our ageing parents can make them feel that getting older means slowly giving up on life.

“Don't lift anything heavy.”
“You're getting old, forgetting is normal.”
“At this age, why change anything?”
“You've worked enough. Just rest now.”

Most of these things come from a place of love, concern and wanting to protect them.

But are we sometimes confusing protection with limitation?

One thing I've learnt through years of working with people across different age groups is that ageing doesn't mean we stop needing strength, movement, purpose, connection or independence.

In fact, these things become even more important as we grow older.

Our parents still need to build and maintain muscle. They need nourishing food, quality sleep, mental stimulation, meaningful relationships and something to look forward to every morning.

They need to feel heard, valued and capable.

And when they experience pain, memory changes, fatigue or emotional struggles, we shouldn't automatically dismiss everything as "just old age."

Of course, ageing brings physiological changes. Some people may have medical conditions, mobility limitations or health complications that require individualised care and professional guidance.

But that doesn't mean we stop working on the foundations of good health.

This is what we believe in Foundational Medicine.

It's never too late to improve a habit, learn something new, build strength or find a new purpose.

And perhaps, as children, one of the greatest gifts we can give our parents is not just taking care of them, but encouraging them to continue taking care of themselves.

To remind them that their life still has so much to offer.

You cannot stop ageing. But you can influence how you age.

❤️ Share this with someone who has ageing parents. Sometimes, changing the way we speak to them can change the way they see their own ageing.

#HealthyAgeing #FoundationalMedicine #SeniorHealth #LifestyleMedicine #AgeingWell".
